name: Home Sweet Home Cafe
notes: Restaurant's own domain (homesweethomecafe.net) times out to fetch (matches router's timeout); wayback snapshots of its breakfast/lunch pages render item names/descriptions with no prices at all (Wix client-side pricing not captured by the crawl). Restaurant-submitted directory data (tier 4, medium) so treated as possibly dated, but price level is plausible for a San Diego diner and internally consistent (no scattered-cent markup pattern). name: Rosarito's Mexican Food #1
notes: Own domain (rosaritosmexicanfoodgo.twupro.com) is on the barred farm-domain list (twupro.com) and was not used. Filed from the Uber Eats store page for the Lake Murray Blvd location (address 6062 Lake Murray Blvd matches batch), extracted from the page's catalogSectionsMap JS state (JSON-LD blocks were too small to hold a full menu). Page's own generated FAQ schema said the store was 'unavailable on Uber Eats at this time', which is contradicted by isOrderable:true and a full live catalog elsewhere on the same page - treated as stale/templated FAQ boilerplate, not a real signal, especially since a live Google search snippet of the same Uber Eats URL shows matching current items (Special 6, Combo 15) and independent sources (Yelp, TripAdvisor, a Facebook foodie group) all corroborate this as a well-known, very cheap ('99 cent Tijuana style tacos', 'Taco Tuesday half off') taco shop, consistent with the low prices extracted. Confidence held at medium (delivery-platform-only, no first-party cross-check possible since the true domain is barred). Two 'Carne Asada Burrito' lines appear under Burritos at different prices ($7.75 and $7.69) - both are directly sourced from the same page, kept as-is rather than guessing which is stale; not a fabricated price.

name: @Spacebar Cafe
notes: Own domain (atspacebar.com) times out on direct fetch, matching the router's original finding. Used a Wayback Machine snapshot of the /menu page, which unusually rendered all daypart tabs (Breakfast, Lunch, Tapas, Dinner) in one static capture with full prices; footer shows a 2023 copyright, so this is roughly a 3-year-old snapshot - filed at medium confidence rather than high given the site's age and unverified currency. Address confirmed via the page itself: 7454 University Ave, Suite A, La Mesa, CA 91942 (same as batch). Internal price conflict: 'Spanish Style Lamb Chops' and 'Filet of Salmon Bites' appear at $20 once (embedded Tapas subsection of the Lunch page) and $15 twice (the dedicated Tapas page and the Dinner page); used $15 since it's the majority/consistent value and dropped the $20 duplicate rather than inventing a resolution. Breakfast-only items (Croissants/Bagels/Panini bases) list a base price with 'Add Bacon/Turkey/Ham $4' as a modifier note, not filed as a separate dish per the base item's description.

Side Orders section intentionally repeats some Appetizer item names (smaller a la carte portions sold separately) per the site's own structure, kept as-is.
